plan.copy_scope: Non-sensitive ordinary source files baked into the task image; no symlinks or dependency/runtime directories
services: Harbor Docker sandbox per case; the configured command runs inside the task container
network: Task execution: no-network inside the Harbor container (egress-control sidecar)
Orchestration: the harbor CLI runs unsandboxed and needs the Docker socket; image builds may pull base images
plan.cost_note: 真实模型按所选 OpenAI 兼容服务计费；金额费用未知，运行前另设调用次数上限。
plan.cleanup: Per-case child processes and local services are reaped; evidence files retained in Evalith
limitations: 容器即隔离边界：harbor CLI 以受监管的非沙箱进程编排 Docker；评分与证据判定在 Evalith 侧进行
基础镜像固定为 python:3.13-slim；需要其他运行时需另行扩展
Harbor reward 仅作记录，不是判定来源；任务镜像会保留在本地 Docker 缓存
